_doc: T3823 (incident class local-host-fanout): host-wide cap on local game-host launches (tsfp-bevy, tsfp_host) on the owner PC, enforced by tools/local_game_slots.py through flock slots <main checkout>/<lock_dir>/local-game-slot-<k>. Rule 26: the owner PC is never an overflow target; heavy runs go remote-first (python3 -m tools.wt replay submit). Interactive play.sh windows are exempt but counted. Offline Tier 2 runs (--t2-offline) start no game and are not counted.
